lessons: Known pre-dispatch item count/UUID changes are re-observed with a finite budget. Unknown movement results are not replayed.
Ordinary material stacks can be reselected nearby after a source UUID vanishes; log that this is a new pickup, not proof of identical entity lineage.
Micro ground pickup checks support, body clearance, hazards, a short descent, then actual inventory gain.
Create standing headroom before opening the lowest foundation layer.
Select the tool before moving to a verified mining pose. Occluded targets are logged and skipped for the rest of the session.
Stop batch printing when its exact cells match and the server queue is settled; this is not whole-goal completion.
